title: SentinelX Event Contract
description: Normalized security telemetry event emitted by Ingestion Service (M3)

event_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifier of the event

source_ip.description: Source IP address or hostname of the traffic/actor

destination_ip.description: Destination IP address of monitored target

event_type.description: Normalized event classification (e.g. auth_failed, connection_attempt, web_access)

target_host.description: Target hostname from log line or ingestion request

event_time.description: UTC timestamp when the event occurred at source

ingest_time.description: UTC timestamp when SentinelX ingested the event

raw_payload.description: Original raw log line or payload

details.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata extracted by log parsers
